The notification system shall suppress duplicate alerts where possible.
The system shall allow staff to tune noncritical notifications without blocking truly important notifications.
Some notifications shall be sent immediately.
Some notifications shall be batched or delayed to avoid interrupting staff during busy periods.
The notification system shall provide different levels of detail for different users.
The notification system shall not show the same case information to all users.
Notifications shall comply with policy and confidentiality rules.
Notifications shall include enough information to be useful.
Notifications shall not expose information to the wrong audience.
The system shall account for evenings when staffing coverage is not always constant.
The system shall account for weekends when staffing coverage is not always constant.
The system shall account for times when fewer people are available.
The system shall enforce policy rules governing who can override a notification or reassign an urgent item.
The system shall prevent notification override and urgent item reassignment from being available to everyone.
The system shall give supervisors more flexibility to override notifications or reassign urgent items.
